fire: Our physics club borrowed a Van de Graaff generator for the science fair.
The first large machine was built by Robert Van de Graaff at Princeton in 1929.
The town of Graaff-Reinet is one of the oldest in South Africa.
Her dissertation on medieval hymns was published by De Graaf in Nieuwkoop.
The Dutch footballer Hans de Graaf scored twice in the cup final.
According to Kenneth Graff, the elephants need fresh browse every day.
The anatomy textbook by Van de Graaff and Fox is used in many nursing courses.
In the second act, the showgirl Janet Van de Graaff finally appears on stage.
